verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing supports declarative spending-control rules (merchant category/country/amount limits) that automatically approve/decline authorizations, plus real-time webhooks that let you programmatically evaluate and act on each authorization event, and ML risk scores that fire on every authorization for agent use cases. This is rule-based automation tied to a narrow event type (card authorizations) rather than a general-purpose rules/automation engine spanning arbitrary events and actions. Missing for 10: evidence of a broader rules engine covering multiple event types (disputes, funding, cardholder lifecycle) and multi-step automated workflows beyond authorization approve/decline.
